subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — per-token breakpoint & safety-net request
messages:
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@novaanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — evaluating commit tiers for Q1

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency numbers look great. We ran some quick volume modelling overnight and have a preliminary ask: Nova would be willing to commit to a 12-month hosted API contract, but we need a tiered per-token rate that materially beats the public rate card once we cross 30B tokens/month. Rough outline:

- Month 1-2 (pilot): low-volume safety net — we won't be at full scale yet, can you provide a capped trial price?
- Stepped discounts beyond 30B and again at 75B tokens/month
- We also need clarity on overage handling if we spike beyond the commit for a month

Can you share what flexibility you have on per-token breakpoints and whether Redwood can give a short-term safety-net / cap for the first 60 days? If there is an internal approval path for a custom slab, please loop in the right folks.

Also attaching our rough usage projection (attached).

Thanks,
Tom
VP Product, Nova Analytics
(attachment: nebula_usage_projection_20261010.csv)

Hi Tom — appreciate the projection and clear target breakpoints.

Quick answers up front: we can consider a custom slab for monthly token breakpoints and a 60-day safety-cap for the pilot, but anything outside the published rate card requires approval from pricing/OPS (cc'd).

Ben & Marcus — can you review Nova's projection and outline a proposed pragmatic exception path? In particular:
- Proposed per-token rates at >30B and >75B tokens/month
- Safety-net structure (a pilot cap that limits spend for first 60 days)
- Overage formula when spikes exceed committed amount

Tom — I included Ben and Marcus to build an internal proposal; Laura Bennett from RevOps will need to sign off on any slab exceptions before we present a term sheet. Once we have an internal recommendation I can share a short-term commitment + DocuSign path.

Best,
Irene

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — internal proposal for Nova Analytics

I pulled Nova's projection into our cost model and sketched a conservative exception we could route for approval. Notes below — open to tightening numbers if legal / finance push back.

High-level proposed exception (12-month commitment):
- Baseline: published rate card applies up to 30B tokens/month
- Breakpoint A (>30B/month): 28% off published per-token rate
- Breakpoint B (>75B/month): 36% off published per-token rate
- Safety-net (pilot): First 60 days — hard cap on spend at $75k; any usage beyond cap billed at published overage rate, but customer not liable for penalties tied to missing long-term commit during pilot window
- Overage handling: month-over-month overage billed at published per-token rate; if sustained >25% over commit for 3 months we trigger review & top-up commit adjustment

Rationale: discounts map to unit-cost tiers and preserve margin at scale; safety-net protects the customer during onboarding but preserves our ability to recover if production load exceeds projections.

Approval path: Laura (RevOps) to greenlight exception and record adjusted pricing in Salesforce; Legal to include a short addendum with the safety-net language; Finance to sign off on margin thresholds.

Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_irdraft.pdf (term sheet + margin calc)

If approved, we can present this as a signed 12-month commit with a 60-day pilot safety cap. I'll need Laura to confirm whether a one-time trial credit is preferred to a cap.

-Ben
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(attachment: proposed_term_sheet_irdraft.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — internal proposal for Nova Analytics

Thanks Ben — solid starting point. I approve routing this as an exception under the following guardrails:

1) Approve the structure of Breakpoint A/B as submitted with the following caveat: the Breakpoint B discount (36%) requires a baseline contract minimum ARR of $2.5M (so that margin floors hold). If Nova's signed commit calc doesn't meet that ARR threshold we tighten breakpoint B to 32%.
2) Safety-net: prefer a $50k one-time onboarding credit + 60-day commit review rather than a hard spend cap. Credits reduce contract complexity and are easier for legal to track.
3) Require an ROI memo from the AE (Irene) summarizing expected token ramp by month, top three production use cases, and expected P95 latency SLO. Upload that to the HubSpot deal before sending to Legal.
4) Record the exception in Salesforce under deal HS-987342 and mark as "pricing exception — RevOps approved pending legal."

I will ping Legal once the ROI memo and term sheet are in HubSpot. Ben — please confirm whether Nova's projection gets the ARR to support current Breakpoint B, otherwise we propose 32% there.

- Laura
Director, RevOps, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Final offer: 12-month commit + pilot credit — next steps

Tom / Elsie — thanks for the patience while we routed internally. Quick summary of what is approved and the steps to finalize: 

What Redwood will offer (subject to signature):
- 12-month hosted API commitment.
- Breakpoint A (>30B tokens/month): 28% off published per-token rate.
- Breakpoint B (>75B tokens/month): 36% off published per-token rate IF the signed commit meets ARR floor of $2.5M; otherwise Breakpoint B is 32%.
- Pilot/onboarding: one-time $50k credit applied to first invoice + 60-day review to confirm ramp.
- Overage: billed at published per-token rate; sustained >25% over-commit for 3 months triggers commercial review (standard).

Next steps we need from Nova:
1) Please confirm the signed ARR target so we can lock in Breakpoint B at 36% if applicable.
2) I will upload a short ROI memo and the final term sheet to HubSpot (deal HS-987342).
3) Once confirmed, Legal will issue a slim addendum; we will route DocuSign for signature.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-987342
Draft DocuSign — https://www.docusign.com/exec?doc=A1B2C3-NEBULA-SIGN

If that looks good I'll queue Legal. Thanks all — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the safety-net language.

Best,
Irene
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
